Marine life list rewritten to match sourced species (dogtooth tuna, giant trevally, grey reef/whitetip/hammerhead/tiger sharks, manta cleaning station, green/hawksbill turtles). Re-audited 2026-08-25: depth corrected 20m -> 35m per dive-the-world.com ('wall with wreck at 35m'). Location (southwest tip of North Atoll) confirmed by dan.org, matching existing text. WRECK HISTORY UNRESOLVED: vessel name ('SS Malayan'), build date, and sinking cause/date could not be confirmed by 2+ independent sources -- only one weakly-attributed source suggests the name, and that same source cluster reports conflicting dates (WWII vs. late 1970s/80s); no source anywhere gives length or tonnage. Per anti-hallucination policy these specifics are described in the markdown as unconfirmed/disputed rather than asserted as fact. Marine-life list corrected to sourced species (grey reef/whitetip sharks, nurse sharks, hammerheads, gorgonian fans with pygmy seahorses, African pompano, leaf scorpionfish, rainbow runners, bumphead parrotfish, batfish, marble rays, giant morays, bannerfish, bluelined snapper, chevron barracuda, hawksbill turtles); removed unsourced 'Spanish dancers' and 'harlequin ghost pipefish' claims. Advanced difficulty confirmed correct per policy.

Re-audited 2026-08-25: location specified as South Atoll (confirmed by dan.org and thediveglobe.com, both direct-fetched). Depth corrected 40m -> 33m per philippinedives.com (18-33m); dan.org/thediveglobe.com describe the wreck remains themselves as shallower (12-18m) with an associated wall/crevasse to 33-40m. WRECK HISTORY: vessel name 'Delsan'/'M/V Delsan' and type ('small Filipino freighter') confirmed by 2 independent direct-fetched sources (dan.org, thediveglobe.com). Grounding date: dan.org specifically reports the vessel struck the reef at night in 1981; a second, less precisely-attributed source cluster corroborates a general 1980s grounding -- both are reflected in the markdown rather than asserting a single date as certain. No source gives tonnage or length -- omitted. REMOVED FABRICATIONS: previous markdown claimed 'massive engine still intact', a 'Disneyland' nickname, and a named 30m crevasse called 'The Cut' -- none of these appear in any of the 4 sources consulted (the 'engine intact' and 'Disneyland' claims are not corroborated anywhere; 'The Cut' crevasse feature is attributed by sources to Malayan Wreck, not Delsan, though philippinedives.com does independently describe an unnamed 'sheltered crevasse at 23m' at Delsan, which is retained without the borrowed name). Marine life list corrected to sourced species across all 4 sources. Advanced difficulty confirmed correct per policy.

tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-08-25: depth corrected 30m -> 40m per philippinedives.com (7-40m working range); dive-the-world.com independently confirms the reef 'drops to more than 50m' beyond the working range. Structural description corrected: sources describe an isolated, mushroom-shaped reef/wall complex roughly 20km north of the main atolls (dive-the-world.com, philippinedives.com, justgottadive.com) rather than a circular atoll enclosing an interior lagoon as the previous markdown stated -- that specific 'interior lagoon' framing was not corroborated by any source and has been removed. Marine life corrected to sourced species (barracuda, Spanish mackerel, Napoleon wrasse, unicornfish, surgeonfish, grey reef sharks confirmed by 3 sources; manta/eagle rays, hammerhead/mako/thresher sharks, turtles, whale sharks, groupers each single-sourced but site-specific).
